a.clause: (a) no dataset's cell-weighted consistent share may fall

b.clause: (b) the aggregate cell-weighted inconsistent share must not rise

c.clause: (c) every move attributable cluster by cluster, zero unexplained

d.clause: (d) the finer name must be the author's own label for those clusters
d.disclosure: the pre-registered clause reads the ADOPTED (demand) clusters and they all carry the name as their author label. Reported beside it, because the brief also says the adoption 'must not invent a term the author never used for those cells': of the 92 clusters the increment renames, only 3 have that term as their author label; the other 89 are clusters the author labelled something else.

e.clause: (e) the kill switch restores the pre-flip default byte-for-byte
e.note: the whitelist is empty in every state, so the registered default-OFF increment and the pre-card commit answer the recorded set with the same bytes (raw and canonical); this is also the state the card leaves on disk.

consequence_per_the_brief: clause 5 of the brief: do not merge into the default route; leave the increment registered default-off and complete the card with the numbers
